tours.list.allDoneBody.en: That’s the gist. The tutorials on tiledash.app go further.
tours.list.allDoneBody.context: Text of the checklist once every task is done. tiledash.app is the website, not translated.

tours.list.closeList.context: Second button of the finished checklist: puts it away for good.

tours.list.foldList.context: Label (for screen readers and on hover) of the button that folds the checklist into a small pill.

tours.list.hideList.context: Link at the bottom of the checklist: puts it away. It can come back with "Take the tour again" in the account menu.

tours.list.listCount.context: Under the checklist’s title and progress bar: how many of its tasks are done.

tours.list.listDoneTitle.context: Title of the getting-started checklist once everything on it is done.

tours.list.listTitle.context: Title of the getting-started checklist in the bottom corner, and of the pill it folds into.

tours.list.taskFirst.context: First task of the getting-started checklist.

tours.list.taskFirstBody.en: The + beside Dashboards suggests one from your Homey’s rooms.
tours.list.taskFirstBody.context: Explanation under the task "Make your first dashboard": the + button next to the Dashboards heading in the sidebar opens a wizard that suggests dashboards.

tours.list.taskPanel.context: Checklist task: set up a wall panel, a tablet on the wall that shows dashboards full screen.

tours.list.taskPanelBody.en: A wall panel shows your dashboards full screen and dims at night.
tours.list.taskPanelBody.context: Explanation under the checklist task "Put it on a tablet".

tours.list.taskRoom.en: Make a dashboard for a room
tours.list.taskRoom.context: Checklist task: make a second dashboard, for one room of the house.

tours.list.taskRoomBody.en: The + beside Dashboards suggests one from your Homey’s rooms.
tours.list.taskRoomBody.context: Explanation under the task "Make a dashboard for a room": the + button next to the Dashboards heading in the sidebar.

tours.list.taskSwitch.context: Checklist task: turn a light or a plug on or off from a dashboard.

tours.list.taskSwitchBody.en: Tap a light or a plug on your dashboard.
tours.list.taskSwitchBody.context: Explanation under the checklist task "Switch something".

tours.list.taskTheme.context: Checklist task: look at the themes (the colours and fonts of dashboards).

tours.list.taskThemeBody.en: Dark, light, e-ink or one of your own.
tours.list.taskThemeBody.context: Explanation under the checklist task "Try a theme": kinds of themes there are.

tours.list.taskWidget.context: Checklist task: add a tile (a widget) to a dashboard.

tours.list.taskWidgetBody.en: Open the dashboard’s options, choose Edit, then Add a widget.
tours.list.taskWidgetBody.context: Explanation under the checklist task "Add a widget". Edit and Add a widget are the names of the menu item and button the person will find.

tours.list.tutorials.context: Button of the finished checklist: opens the tutorials on the website in a new tab.

tours.steps.back.context: Button of a tour step: goes to the step before.

tours.steps.basicsBody.en: A short list of things to try is in the corner. Take your time; it keeps your place.
tours.steps.basicsBody.context: Text of the card at the end of the guided tour. The list is the getting-started checklist in the bottom corner, which remembers what was done.

tours.steps.basicsTitle.context: Title of the card at the end of the guided tour.

tours.steps.endTour.context: Label (for screen readers and on hover) of the × button that closes the tour.

tours.steps.finish.context: Button of the last tour step, in place of Next.

tours.steps.homeBody.en: Lights on, the temperature, what’s open. Tap one to see which devices it counts.
tours.steps.homeBody.context: Text of the first tour step. The chips are the small summaries next to the dashboard’s name (total power, how many lights are on, which doors or windows are open).

tours.steps.homeTitle.context: Title of the first step of the first-dashboard tour, pointing at the summaries beside the dashboard’s name (small chips such as "3 lights on" or "21 °C").

tours.steps.next.context: Button of a tour step: goes to the next step.

tours.steps.optionsBody.en: Always here, top right: change the dashboard, its settings, put it on a tablet or share it.
tours.steps.optionsBody.context: Text of the tour step pointing at the dashboard’s options button.

tours.steps.plan3dBody.en: The cube switches between your drawing and a 3D view. In 3D, drag with the right mouse button to turn it.
tours.steps.plan3dBody.context: Text of the floor planner tour’s step at the cube button: how to see and turn the 3D view.

tours.steps.plan3dTitle.context: Title of the floor planner tour’s step at the cube button in the top bar.

tours.steps.planEndBody.en: The (?) up here starts this tour again. Press ? for every control and shortcut.
tours.steps.planEndBody.context: Text of that card. (?) is the round button with a question mark in the top bar; "?" is the key on the keyboard.

tours.steps.planEndTitle.context: Title of the card at the end of the floor planner tour.

tours.steps.planSafeBody.en: Undo takes back any change, and the plan saves by itself. Space and drag moves around; scroll zooms.
tours.steps.planSafeBody.context: Text of that step: nothing can go wrong, and how to move around the plan.

tours.steps.planSafeTitle.context: Title of the floor planner tour’s step at the undo button in the top bar.

tours.steps.planToolsBody.en: Pick a tool here: rooms and walls first, then doors and windows, furniture and your devices.
tours.steps.planToolsBody.context: Text of that step: the tools in the column, in the order people usually use them.

tours.steps.planToolsTitle.context: Title of the floor planner tour’s first step, at the column of drawing tools on the left.

tours.steps.settingsEndBody.en: The (?) up here starts this tour again, any time.
tours.steps.settingsEndBody.context: Text of that card. (?) is the round button with a question mark in the window’s header.

tours.steps.settingsEndTitle.context: Title of the card at the end of the dashboard settings tour.

tours.steps.settingsLookBody.en: A theme just for this dashboard and, with Pro, a picture behind the tiles. Dim and blur keep the tiles easy to read.
tours.steps.settingsLookBody.context: Text of that step. Pro is the paid plan; dim and blur are settings of the background picture.

tours.steps.settingsLookTitle.context: Title of the dashboard settings tour’s step on the Look tab.

tours.steps.settingsPopupsBody.en: Pick what sets one off, like the doorbell, and what shows: a camera, a device or another dashboard. It closes again after a while.
tours.steps.settingsPopupsBody.context: Text of that step: how a popup on an event is set up.

tours.steps.settingsPopupsTitle.context: Title of the dashboard settings tour’s step on the Popups tab.

tours.steps.settingsSpacingBody.en: Snug, Comfortable or Roomy, with pixels under Fine-tune. Fit to screen puts everything on one screen, good for a wall tablet.
tours.steps.settingsSpacingBody.context: Text of the dashboard settings tour’s step on the Layout tab. Snug, Comfortable and Roomy are the names of spacing choices; Fine-tune is a folded part; Fit to screen is a switch.

tours.steps.settingsSpacingTitle.context: Title of the dashboard settings tour’s step on the Layout tab, about the room between tiles.

tours.steps.showMyList.context: Button of the card at the end of the tour: closes it and shows the checklist.

tours.steps.stepCount.context: Above a tour step’s title: which step this is of how many.

params.step: The number of this step, from 1.

tours.steps.tabletChooseBody.en: Which dashboards it shows, and what kind of screen it is. Each has an answer ready, so Next all the way works.
tours.steps.tabletChooseBody.context: Text of that step: what the dialog asks after the code.

tours.steps.tabletChooseTitle.context: Title of the tour step pointing at the row of steps in the dialog.

tours.steps.tabletCodeBody.en: On the tablet, open the address shown here, or scan the QR code. Type the code it shows and choose Connect.
tours.steps.tabletCodeBody.context: Text of that step. Connect is the button that checks the code.

tours.steps.tabletCodeTitle.context: Title of the tour step pointing at the part of the dialog where the person types the code the tablet shows.

tours.steps.tabletEndBody.en: Change it later under Wall panels in the sidebar. The dialog stays open for you to finish.
tours.steps.tabletEndBody.context: Text of that card. Wall panels is a fold in the sidebar listing the tablets on the wall.

tours.steps.tabletEndTitle.context: Title of the card at the end of the tour "Put a dashboard on the wall".

tours.steps.tabletIntroBody.en: It shows your dashboards full screen: swipe between them. It dims when nobody uses it, and wakes for alerts like the doorbell.
tours.steps.tabletIntroBody.context: Text of that step: what a tablet on the wall (a wall panel) does.

tours.steps.tabletIntroTitle.context: Title of the first step of the tour "Put a dashboard on the wall": what a wall panel is.

tours.steps.tileBody.en: Tiles do what they show. A buttons tile has a button for each light, Mood or Flow.
tours.steps.tileBody.context: Text of the tour step that points at a tile of a light or a plug. A buttons tile is one tile with several buttons; Moods and Flows are Homey’s words, keep them as Homey translates them.

tours.steps.tileTitle.context: Title of the tour step that points at a tile of a light or a plug on the dashboard.

tours.steps.tileTried.context: Replaces "Try it: tap a light" once the person tapped it and the device switched. Warm and short.

tours.steps.tileTry.context: Hint in a dashed box on the tile step, asking the person to tap the tile it points at.

tours.steps.tourAgain.en: You can take the tour again from the account menu.
tours.steps.tourAgain.context: Small print at the bottom of the card at the end of the tour.

tours.steps.wallEndAction.context: Button of that card: starts a short tour that puts the dashboard on a tablet.

tours.steps.wallEndBody.en: It takes a minute: open one address on the tablet and type its code here.
tours.steps.wallEndBody.context: Text of the card at the end of the first-dashboard tour, for someone with a tablet on the wall: how putting a dashboard on it works.

tours.steps.wallEndNote.en: Or later, from ⋯ or the list in the corner.
tours.steps.wallEndNote.context: Small print under that button: the same can be done later from the dashboard’s ⋯ button or the getting-started list.

tours.steps.wallEndTitle.en: Next: put it on the wall
tours.steps.wallEndTitle.context: Title of the card at the end of the first-dashboard tour, for someone who said they’ll use a tablet on the wall.
